name: input-group
title: Input group
description: Joins an input with addons (text, icons) and actions (buttons) into one bordered control.

when: A custom input needs prefix or suffix text, icons or buttons.

instead.when: No addon or action is needed; `type` already covers search, password and phone.
The addon is a choice from a list.

builtIn: Pressing an addon focuses the input.
youProvide: Labels for actions that show only an icon.

InputGroup.name: multiline
InputGroup.description: Multi-line content (TextArea): items align to the top.

InputGroup.name: dir
InputGroup.description: `ltr` keeps the frame left to right on an RTL page (phone numbers, IBANs).

InputGroup.name: id
InputGroup.description:
The control's id, description link and invalid state. A `Field` around the group sets them; the group hands
them to its `InputGroupInput`, so the label and the error reach the input, not the frame.

InputAddon.name: position
InputAddon.description: Which side of the value it sits on.

InputAddon.name: flush
InputAddon.description: Flush with the frame edge (default). Off when another part, such as a stepper, follows an end addon.

InputAddon.name: onClick
InputAddon.description: Extra handler; focus forwarding to the control always runs as well.

InputAction.name: suppressHydrationWarning
InputAction.description:
A React-only flag that suppresses the warning React normally logs when an element's
server-rendered content doesn't match the client render during hydration. See [React
docs](https://react.dev/reference/react-dom/client/hydrateRoot#suppressing-unavoidable-hydration-mismatch-errors).

InputAction.name: autoFocus
InputAction.description: Whether the element should receive focus on render.

InputAction.name: id
InputAction.description:
The element's unique identifier. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/id).

InputAction.name: slot
InputAction.description:
A slot name for the component. Slots allow the component to receive props from a parent
component. An explicit `null` value indicates that the local props completely override all
props received from a parent.

InputAction.name: aria-controls
InputAction.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current
element.

InputAction.name: aria-current
InputAction.description:
Indicates whether this element represents the current item within a container or set of related
elements.

InputAction.name: aria-describedby
InputAction.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

InputAction.name: aria-details
InputAction.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed, extended description for the
object.

InputAction.name: aria-disabled
InputAction.description: Indicates whether the element is disabled to users of assistive technology.

InputAction.name: aria-expanded
InputAction.description:
Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded
or collapsed.

InputAction.name: aria-haspopup
InputAction.description:
Indicates the availability and type of interactive popup element, such as menu or dialog, that
can be triggered by an element.

InputAction.name: aria-label
InputAction.description:
Defines a string value that labels the current element.
Names the action ("Kopyala", "Temizle").

InputAction.name: aria-labelledby
InputAction.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

InputAction.name: aria-pressed
InputAction.description: Indicates the current "pressed" state of toggle buttons.

InputAction.name: onFocus
InputAction.description: Handler that is called when the element receives focus.

InputAction.name: onBlur
InputAction.description: Handler that is called when the element loses focus.

InputAction.name: onKeyDown
InputAction.description: Handler that is called when a key is pressed.

InputAction.name: onKeyUp
InputAction.description: Handler that is called when a key is released.

InputAction.name: onClick
InputAction.description:
**Not recommended – use `onPress` instead.** `onClick` is an alias for `onPress`
provided for compatibility with other libraries. `onPress` provides
additional event details for non-mouse interactions.

InputAction.name: isDisabled
InputAction.description: Whether the button is disabled.

InputAction.name: onPress
InputAction.description: Handler that is called when the press is released over the target.

InputAction.name: onPressStart
InputAction.description: Handler that is called when a press interaction starts.

InputAction.name: onPressEnd
InputAction.description:
Handler that is called when a press interaction ends, either
over the target or when the pointer leaves the target.

InputAction.name: onPressChange
InputAction.description: Handler that is called when the press state changes.

InputAction.name: onPressUp
InputAction.description:
Handler that is called when a press is released over the target, regardless of
whether it started on the target or not.

InputAction.name: onFocusChange
InputAction.description: Handler that is called when the element's focus status changes.

InputAction.name: type
InputAction.description: The behavior of the button when used in an HTML form.

InputAction.name: preventFocusOnPress
InputAction.description:
Whether to prevent focus from moving to the button when pressing it.

Caution, this can make the button inaccessible and should only be used when alternative
keyboard interaction is provided, such as ComboBox's MenuTrigger or a NumberField's
increment/decrement control.

InputAction.name: form
InputAction.description:
The `<form>` element to associate the button with.
The value of this attribute must be the id of a `<form>` in the same document.
See [MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/button#form).

InputAction.name: formAction
InputAction.description:
The URL that processes the information submitted by the button.
Overrides the action attribute of the button's form owner.

InputAction.name: formEncType
InputAction.description: Indicates how to encode the form data that is submitted.

InputAction.name: formMethod
InputAction.description: Indicates the HTTP method used to submit the form.

InputAction.name: formNoValidate
InputAction.description: Indicates that the form is not to be validated when it is submitted.

InputAction.name: formTarget
InputAction.description: Overrides the target attribute of the button's form owner.

InputAction.name: name
InputAction.description: Submitted as a pair with the button's value as part of the form data.

InputAction.name: value
InputAction.description: The value associated with the button's name when it's submitted with the form data.

InputAction.name: excludeFromTabOrder
InputAction.description:
Whether to exclude the element from the sequential tab order. If true,
the element will not be focusable via the keyboard by tabbing. This should
be avoided except in rare scenarios where an alternative means of accessing
the element or its functionality via the keyboard is available.

InputAction.name: isPending
InputAction.description:
Whether the button is in a pending state. This disables press and hover events
while retaining focusability, and announces the pending state to screen readers.

InputAction.name: onHoverStart
InputAction.description: Handler that is called when a hover interaction starts.

InputAction.name: onHoverEnd
InputAction.description: Handler that is called when a hover interaction ends.

InputAction.name: onHoverChange
InputAction.description: Handler that is called when the hover state changes.

InputAction.name: render
InputAction.description:
Overrides the default DOM element with a custom render function.
This allows rendering existing components with built-in styles and behaviors
such as router links, animation libraries, and pre-styled components.

Requirements:

- You must render the expected element type (e.g. if `<button>` is expected, you cannot render an
  `<a>`).
- Only a single root DOM element can be rendered (no fragments).
- You must pass through props and ref to the underlying DOM element, merging with your own prop
  as appropriate.

InputAction.name: icon
InputAction.description: Lucide icon name ("copy", "circle-x").

InputGroupInput.name: inputMode
InputGroupInput.description: Hints at the type of data that might be entered by the user while editing the element or its contents

InputGroupInput.name: is
InputGroupInput.description: Specify that a standard HTML element should behave like a defined custom built-in element

InputGroupInput.name: aria-activedescendant
InputGroupInput.description: Identifies the currently active element when DOM focus is on a composite widget, textbox, group, or application.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-atomic
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates whether assistive technologies will present all, or only parts of, the changed region based on the change notifications defined by the aria-relevant attribute.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-autocomplete
InputGroupInput.description:
Indicates whether inputting text could trigger display of one or more predictions of the user's intended value for an input and specifies how predictions would be
presented if they are made.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-braillelabel
InputGroupInput.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element, which is intended to be converted into Braille.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-brailleroledescription
InputGroupInput.description: Defines a human-readable, author-localized abbreviated description for the role of an element, which is intended to be converted into Braille.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-checked
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates the current "checked" state of checkboxes, radio buttons, and other widgets.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-colcount
InputGroupInput.description: Defines the total number of columns in a table, grid, or treegrid.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-colindex
InputGroupInput.description: Defines an element's column index or position with respect to the total number of columns within a table, grid, or treegrid.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-colindextext
InputGroupInput.description: Defines a human readable text alternative of aria-colindex.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-colspan
InputGroupInput.description: Defines the number of columns spanned by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-controls
InputGroupInput.description: Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current element.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-current
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates the element that represents the current item within a container or set of related elements.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-describedby
InputGroupInput.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-description
InputGroupInput.description: Defines a string value that describes or annotates the current element.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-details
InputGroupInput.description: Identifies the element that provides a detailed, extended description for the object.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-disabled
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates that the element is perceivable but disabled, so it is not editable or otherwise operable.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-dropeffect
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates what functions can be performed when a dragged object is released on the drop target.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-errormessage
InputGroupInput.description: Identifies the element that provides an error message for the object.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-expanded
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded or collapsed.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-flowto
InputGroupInput.description:
Identifies the next element (or elements) in an alternate reading order of content which, at the user's discretion,
allows assistive technology to override the general default of reading in document source order.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-grabbed
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates an element's "grabbed" state in a drag-and-drop operation.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-haspopup
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates the availability and type of interactive popup element, such as menu or dialog, that can be triggered by an element.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-hidden
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates whether the element is exposed to an accessibility API.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-invalid
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates the entered value does not conform to the format expected by the application.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-keyshortcuts
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates keyboard shortcuts that an author has implemented to activate or give focus to an element.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-label
InputGroupInput.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-labelledby
InputGroupInput.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-level
InputGroupInput.description: Defines the hierarchical level of an element within a structure.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-live
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates that an element will be updated, and describes the types of updates the user agents, assistive technologies, and user can expect from the live region.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-modal
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates whether an element is modal when displayed.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-multiline
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates whether a text box accepts multiple lines of input or only a single line.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-multiselectable
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates that the user may select more than one item from the current selectable descendants.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-orientation
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates whether the element's orientation is horizontal, vertical, or unknown/ambiguous.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-owns
InputGroupInput.description:
Identifies an element (or elements) in order to define a visual, functional, or contextual parent/child relationship
between DOM elements where the DOM hierarchy cannot be used to represent the relationship.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-placeholder
InputGroupInput.description:
Defines a short hint (a word or short phrase) intended to aid the user with data entry when the control has no value.
A hint could be a sample value or a brief description of the expected format.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-posinset
InputGroupInput.description: Defines an element's number or position in the current set of listitems or treeitems. Not required if all elements in the set are present in the DOM.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-pressed
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates the current "pressed" state of toggle buttons.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-readonly
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates that the element is not editable, but is otherwise operable.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-relevant
InputGroupInput.type: "additions" | "additions removals" | "additions text" | "all" | "removals" | "removals additions" | "removals text" | "text" | "text additions" | "text removals" | undefined
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates what notifications the user agent will trigger when the accessibility tree within a live region is modified.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-required
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates that user input is required on the element before a form may be submitted.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-roledescription
InputGroupInput.description: Defines a human-readable, author-localized description for the role of an element.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-rowcount
InputGroupInput.description: Defines the total number of rows in a table, grid, or treegrid.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-rowindex
InputGroupInput.description: Defines an element's row index or position with respect to the total number of rows within a table, grid, or treegrid.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-rowindextext
InputGroupInput.description: Defines a human readable text alternative of aria-rowindex.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-rowspan
InputGroupInput.description: Defines the number of rows spanned by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-selected
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates the current "selected" state of various widgets.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-setsize
InputGroupInput.description: Defines the number of items in the current set of listitems or treeitems. Not required if all elements in the set are present in the DOM.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-sort
InputGroupInput.description: Indicates if items in a table or grid are sorted in ascending or descending order.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-valuemax
InputGroupInput.description: Defines the maximum allowed value for a range widget.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-valuemin
InputGroupInput.description: Defines the minimum allowed value for a range widget.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-valuenow
InputGroupInput.description: Defines the current value for a range widget.

InputGroupInput.name: aria-valuetext
InputGroupInput.description: Defines the human readable text alternative of aria-valuenow for a range widget.
